strings.title: CSI ANALYSIS
strings.body: Prepare the sample, inspect the observations and complete the analysis. You have {minutes} minutes. Reading this screen does not use your time.
strings.resumeBody: Your sample has waited patiently. Resume when you are ready.
strings.idle: Still investigating, or has the microscope hypnotised you?
strings.time_limit: Analysis timed out. No result was recorded. You can try again.
strings.inactivity: Analysis cancelled after inactivity. No result was recorded. You can try again.
strings.invalid_input: This sample has invalid or unsupported data. No result was recorded.
strings.runtime_error: The analysis could not continue. No result was recorded.
strings.cancelled: Analysis cancelled. No result was recorded.
strings.HairAnalysisScene: Use the tweezers to prepare the strand, apply the reagent and compare it under the microscope.
strings.BloodAnalysisScene: Prepare the blood sample, apply each reagent to its matching well and compare the reactions.
strings.DnaGenderScene: Follow the sample preparation instructions and interpret the genetic profile.
strings.FingerprintPatternScene: Prepare and focus the print, then identify its ridge pattern.
strings.FingerprintScene: Recover the partial fingerprint and complete the analysis.
strings.ShoeprintScene: Inspect the recovered shoeprint and compare the available samples.
strings.ToolmarkAnalysisScene: Press SPACE or tap LOCK FOCUS when the marker is in the target zone. Complete three scans.
strings.ChemicalResidueScene: Process the recovered microscopic residue and complete the analysis.
strings.FiberAnalysisScene: Watch the scanner, then repeat the colour sequence. Complete all rounds.
strings.MaterialAnalysisScene: Watch the scanner, then repeat the colour sequence to identify the recovered material.
